Chapter 428 - 428 It'S Over; Reminder!

Chapter 428 - 428 It's Over; Reminder!

428 It’s Over; Reminder!

The knife and fork in the president’s hand fell onto the table.

He did not know what kind of thesis Lin Fan had submitted to Nature.

However, just hearing this, the president’s heart inexplicably tightened.

Ever since Lin Fan invented the carbon-based chip, the president had conducted an in-depth investigation and research on him.

Lin Fan solved a few unsolved math questions, invented the earthquake prediction device, the human islet recovery drug, the super battery, and so on.

Lin Fan… was definitely an existence with extremely high intelligence that could create miracles.

If he interfered with the chip again, then the consequences… were absolutely terrible!

The vice president of the western region was obviously very wary of Lin Fan. He asked, “What thesis did Professor Lin submit to Nature?”

“The Principles and Future of Gaming Helmets!”

“The Principles and Future of Gaming Helmets?” The leaders looked at each other in confusion.

Gaming helmets?

They had some vague guesses.

However, the Foreign Chip Alliance only cared about chips.

As for gaming helmets, they were not interested.

“According to Hemp Rope Technology University, this gaming helmet has a special function that allows people to enter the game world with their consciousness…” Jack continued.

“In addition, operating this helmet requires a very high chip performance. Perhaps, a carbon-based chip must be used to operate it successfully!”

The cups, knives, and forks in the hands of the leaders fell to the ground.

Their faces turned pale.

They knew very well how attractive this gaming helmet that could enter games was to foreigners!

In the face of carbon-based chips with better performance, the president and vice presidents managed to make ordinary people who did not know the truth refuse to use carbon-based chips and continue to use silicon-based chips through the media and internet trolls on the grounds of environmental protection and health!

Once the gaming helmet appeared, however…

In the eyes of foreigners, what did all that matter?

Were environmental protection and health more important than entering the game world?

Absolutely not!

It was over!

The Foreign Chip Alliance was completely finished!

…

Jiangbei University.

Even though Lin Fan had not come to the office for the past two days, Liu Qianqian, Nie Zhenjiang, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Jiang Chaoqun, and Hao Zhiwu still went to school on time and took the initiative to learn with an extremely serious attitude.

However…

Xia Bing and Xia Xue often unconsciously looked at the empty desk in front of them, and a trace of longing appeared on their pretty faces.

Liu Qianqian saw all of this.

When the school bell rang, Liu Qianqian took the initiative to walk to the dormitory with Xia Bing and Xia Xue.

“Xia Bing, Xia Xue, you two look exactly the same. Are you twins?” Liu Qianqian asked.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue said in unison, “Yes.”

“So, it’s true!” Liu Qianqian was pleasantly surprised. “I heard that twins think the same way. Are you two the same?”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue said, “Most of the time, yes.”

“Are the people and things you like the same?” Liu Qianqian continued.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue nodded slowly.

“Do you like Professor Lin Fan?” Liu Qianqian asked.

Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s pretty faces instantly turned red.

They hurriedly lowered their heads, wishing they could bury their heads in the ground.

Liu Qianqian immediately knew the answer when she saw them like this.

She thought about it and said, “Professor Lin Fan is proficient in mathematics, logistics, biology, chemistry, computer science, and so on. He does have a strong charm!

“But I think it’s best for you to distinguish between liking and worshipping.”

Liu Qianqian saw that the two of them still had no reaction and hesitated for a moment.

“A few days ago, I was in the library. I saw Professor Lin Fan sitting together with a woman, talking and laughing. Moreover, Professor Lin Fan was a mess in front of her, flipping through books randomly.”

Obviously, Liu Qianqian was talking about Lin Fan and Lu Ling reading together.

Lu Ling had scolded Lin Fan for not choosing her as a student, but in Liu Qianqian’s eyes, they were talking and laughing.

Lin Fan used his scanning ability to read, but in Liu Qianqian’s eyes, he was just flipping through books randomly.

Liu Qianqian felt that she had made it obvious enough.

However, Xia Bing and Xia Xue still did not seem to have any reaction. Liu Qianqian could not help but say again, “I think Professor Lin Fan might have a girlfriend.”

After getting along with them for a few days, Liu Qianqian felt that Xia Bing and Xia Xue were kind and nice.

In terms of love affairs, Liu Qianqian thought that she was experienced.

She knew very well how painful it was to find out the person one liked had a partner.

Therefore, she had to pull Xia Bing and Xia Xue over in time before they fell too deep.

However…

Xia Bing and Xia Xue still had their heads lowered. Their pretty faces were red, and they did not have much of a reaction.

Liu Qianqian thought they did not hear her.

Therefore, she said again, “Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Professor Lin Fan probably has a girlfriend.”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue raised their heads and said, “Huh? We know.”

Liu Qianqian heaved a sigh of relief.

At this time, Xia Bing and Xia Xue said, “We’re also Lin Fan’s… girlfriends.”

Liu Qianqian was speechless.

…

Regarding Nature, the Foreign Chip Alliance, and what happened at Jiangbei University, Lin Fan had no idea about them.

Other than eating, drinking, and sleeping, he had been completely immersed in World.

In World, he roamed freely, killing monsters and admiring the beautiful scenery.

This was an unprecedented novelty.

Of course, this novelty did not last forever.

For example, right now, Lin Fan was slowly regaining his composure.

He called the two-star Michelin restaurant.

Not long after…

Top-grade abalone, M9 beef, sea urchin eggs, king crab, and so on were delicately made and sent over.

As Lin Fan ate, he commented, “Although the food in the game has some taste, it’s still different from real food.

“The delicacies in reality have a special feeling of filling the stomach and lasting for a long time. In the game, only when you eat do you have that kind of feeling.”

When all the food on the table was finished, Lin Fan burped.

“By the way, I don’t think I’ve signed in today, right?”

Lin Fan muttered to himself and focused on the sign-in system.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,000,000 yuan.]

Lin Fan pursed his lips and said, “Why is it this again?”

At this moment, the phone next to him rang urgently.

Lin Fan looked at the caller ID. It was Feng Zhixiang from the Institute of Science.
